subject: indiv-td
title: (R)INDIV.TD.------AFL.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-23 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's claim that 'the attempts to suppress this most important phenomenon must not be taken lightly,' immediately following his insistence that affinity-alignment 'in fact does mean something.' (R)INDIV-TD (the reality of individual tendencies) is crossed with AFL (affinity alignment): the question is what individual-tendencies produces in their *actual* instantiation when crossed with affinity-alignment — the (R) prefix marking Braxton's commitment that individual-tendencies actually obtain (against the suppression). AFL is the partner. PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) drops from the main line and leads to INFO-AF-B (information-affinity basis), which carries (C)POST (the concept of postulation), with PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) on it, and RT-DY (reality dynamics). RT-DY leads to VT-ATT (vibrational attitude), which carries T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and RT-OP (reality options). The (c) prefix on POST registers that postulation is the conceptual *output* — what gets formulated *about* the alignment — while projectional-dynamics is its plain operational output.
